articles.title: WhatsApp, Telegram must be tied to an active SIM from Jan 1: DoT issues guidelines
articles.description: The Department of Telecommunications has issued guidelines for messaging apps to link accounts to active SIM cards. Users will need to ensure registered numbers are connected to active SIM cards by January 1, 2027. This measure aims to reduce cyber fraud and misuse of mobile numbers in India. Messaging apps must comply with these rules or risk suspension of functionality.

articles.title: Netflix’s India push lifts Asia-Pacific revenue to $1.54 billion, with record subscriber additions
articles.description: In its third-quarter shareholder letter dated October 20, Netflix said revenue in India grew about 18% year on year on a foreign-exchange-neutral basis. View hours in India rose 24%, while view hours per member grew in the low-to-mid single digits. The company credited a slate led by “Lock Upp,” its first daily reality series, along with the scripted show “Musafir Cafe” and “Operation Safed Sagar.”

articles.title: The Tender247 Story: Turning tender intelligence into a competitive advantage with Anupam Kher
articles.description: Harnessing the power of AI, Tender247 is transforming the landscape for businesses seeking tender opportunities on government platforms. Appointing Anupam Kher as its brand ambassador, the company focuses on simplifying the tender process for smaller businesses. The initiative promises to enhance decision-making capabilities and facilitate greater access to public procurement contracts, resulting in a more inclusive bidding environment.
